podcast.title: Bras Thrown On Stage (2012)
podcast.body: During the 2012 Warped Tour, which featured 41 shows in 51 days, a remarkable 492 bras were thrown onto the stage during All Time Low's performances. "one of the weirdest stats I was able to find was that during the 2012 tour, which featured 41 shows in 51 days, exactly 492 bras were thrown on stage during all time lows sets."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Multiple Warped Tour Appearances
podcast.body: All Time Low is a frequent performer on the Warped Tour, having signed up to play at least half a dozen times. "They are a multiple Warped Tour performer. They signed up at least half a dozen times."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: New Generation Band
podcast.body: All Time Low is mentioned as part of the "new generation of pop punk bands" that began to appear after 2010. "all time low."
